title: Login and reward popups use one styled toast, and one reward raises one toast
detail:
Owner report 2026-11-18 (phone, /feed): on login a hand-rolled emoji pill "Welcome back / Day 117 / +2" sat on the Feed greeting, and a second toast "+2 Gems, Earned on another device" sat on the practice tiles, on the same phone; timer completions raised the same "another device" toasts.

Causes. (1) components/daily-check-in.tsx drew its own fixed top-20 pill outside the toast lane. (2) It showed the VISIT streak (profiles.meta.daily_checkin_streak, 117) under the same word the page uses for the PRACTICE streak (156). (3) Every server-paid reward broadcasts over Realtime (LIVE-671); reward-live.tsx only suppressed echoes of rewards raised through showZapToast, so the check-in gems, the Mindless reveal's Zaps and bonuses, and every other server award came back labelled "Earned on another device", which it cannot know.

Fix. The check-in raises the kit Toast through showZapToast ("Welcome back", "+2 Gems for checking in today", no streak). The lane merges a local and a remote copy of one reward in either order (mergeReward). The Mindless reveal claims the rewards it already counts up (claimReward). Remote rewards are labelled by their ledger action (rewardLabel). Below md the lane is a full-width bar above the tab bar; from md a 20rem corner stack. Reward toasts are dismissible; gems take the signal tone.

Merged: login and reward popups on the kit Toast lane; one toast per reward; no false another-device line; no second streak. Rendered at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920, 2000 light and dark (/mnt/project-files/toasts/).

verify.note: Fails on main: the check-in draws its own pill naming the visit streak, Realtime rewards say another device, no merge, the reveal does not claim, the mobile lane hugs the right edge. Passes when all of those are fixed.
